title: test(ui): pin the direct-URL record form save and nav CEL visibility in Live E2E UI
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg57ReKcW3wEma7daYWHXqAD)_
Fixes #27555

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：必过检查 `Live E2E UI` 多了两个场景：按 URL 直接打开整页编辑表单、改标题、保存，要看到保存提示、留在应用内的记录页、经 API 回读到新值（#27454）；应用导航项的裸字符串 `visible` 按 CEL 求值，为真显示、为假隐藏且不报错（#27457）。`list-row-action-cel.spec.ts` 从夜间清单移入必过清单。
- **为什么改**：这两个缺陷都是合并后才在浏览器里发现的，单元测试没拦住；现在真实前后端栈每个 PR 都会跑它们。
- **风险与回滚**：只动测试和 `ui/package.json` 的两条脚本清单，不改产品代码。本地 `Run the live e2e specs` 步骤从约 35 秒变成约 40 秒，远低于 #27550 的 2 分钟预算。回滚 = 把两个文件名移回 `test:e2e:live:nightly`（新文件删掉即可）。
- **先看**：`ui/e2e/live/record-form-direct-url.spec.ts`；`ui/e2e/live/list-row-action-cel.spec.ts` 的第二个用例；`ui/package.json` 两条脚本。
- **两分钟验证**：看本 PR 的 `Live E2E UI` 检查日志，`Run the live e2e specs` 步骤应列出 15 条全部通过，其中 3 条来自这两个文件，步骤耗时在 2 分钟内。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New `ui/e2e/live/record-form-direct-url.spec.ts` (#27454).** The test creates its own `showcase_task` through the data API (on a seeded project, `status: backlog`), opens `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/ID/edit` with `page.goto` (a fresh page, so the only earlier history entry is `about:blank`, the direct-URL entry the defect needs), renames the title, clicks Save and asserts: the save request answered 2xx; the toast `Task "NEW TITLE" updated` is visible; the URL path is exactly the record's detail path, inside the app; the form page is gone; `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` returns the new title. The task is deleted in `finally`. A new file rather than an extension of `action-modal.spec.ts`: that file is about the modal transport, and a full-page form by URL is a different surface.
- **`ui/e2e/live/list-row-action-cel.spec.ts` gains a navigation case (#27457).** It authors its own package and app through the metadata API the way Studio's menu-entry inspector writes VISIBLE WHEN (a bare string): one entry `'org_owner' in current_user.positions`, one `'e2e_no_such_position' in current_user.positions`, publishes the drafts, opens the app and asserts the first entry is shown, the second is absent, and no `predicate could not be evaluated` line reached the browser console (hidden because false, not because it faulted closed). `in` is CEL-only syntax, so on the legacy evaluator both entries are hidden. The test first asserts the seeded admin's `get-session` positions contain `org_owner`, and deletes the package in `finally`. The existing row-action case is unchanged.
- **`ui/package.json`:** `record-form-direct-url.spec.ts` and `list-row-action-cel.spec.ts` join `test:e2e:live:ci`; `list-row-action-cel.spec.ts` leaves `test:e2e:live:nightly`. Both passed the promotion rule (readings below). Both headers say they are in the `:ci` allowlist since this card, the way `studio-editor.spec.ts` says it.
- No changeset: the diff is tests plus two script lines in `ui/package.json`, the private workspace root (`object-ui-monorepo`, `"private": true`); no published package changes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Finding, for the seat to file (class a).** #27454's fix holds only when the form is opened on the app's package-id address. Opened on the app's NAME alias (`/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task/record/ID/edit` or `/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task/new`, the address every other live spec uses and the form old bookmarks carry), the console first moves the URL to the package-id address with a `replace` navigation (`canonicalAppPathname` effect in `AppContent.tsx`, from #26183). That navigation gives the entry a generated `location.key`, so `RecordFormPage`'s `hasInAppHistory = location.key !== 'default'` reads true and `goBack` runs `navigate(-1)`, out of the document. Measured on this branch's stack, one fresh page per row:

  | Address | Mode | `history.state.key` after load | URL after Save | Toasts |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `showcase_app` (alias) | edit | generated | `about:blank` | 0 |
  | `showcase_app` (alias) | new | generated | `about:blank` | 0 |
  | `com.example.showcase` | edit | none | record detail, in app | 1 |
  | `com.example.showcase` | new | none | object list, in app | 1 |

  In a real tab the alias rows land on whatever page the tab showed before, as in #27454. This spec opens the package-id address, the one the console's own links and the address bar carry, so it pins the fix as delivered; an alias-URL case would be red today and is not added. Dedupe words: `RecordFormPage goBack location.key`, `canonical app pathname replace history`, `direct URL alias save leaves app`.
- Page block `visibleWhen` (#27457's reproduction B) is not added live: the card asks for one navigation case. The jsdom acceptance test `SchemaRenderer.bareCelVisibleWhen-27457.test.tsx` covers it.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `live-e2e-ui` comment still says "the four allowlisted live specs", and `examples/app-showcase/test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts` says "Four of its specs are the required `Live E2E UI` job"; both counts were already stale and are now further off (eight files). `ci.yml` is out of bounds for this card and the test file is outside its file surface; neither count is read by a gate (the test reads the nightly script by name, now 13 specs).
- The project attribution link in the first two lines names this card thread, as the harness requires of a PR the thread opens.

## Verification

All runs: this branch's workspace backend (`ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on `examples/app-showcase`, port 4110) and the Console production build (`VITE_BASE_PATH=/ vite build`) served by `vite preview` on 5290 with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, the `Live E2E UI` job's stack step for step after its turbo build filters; `--retries 0`; one long-lived backend across all runs (the CI job boots a fresh one per run, so this is the harder condition). Shared container, 4 cores.

| Reading | Runs | Result | Playwright total per run (wall) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Incumbent allowlist before this change (control) | 1 | 12/12 | 34.8 s (36.0 s) |
| The two specs, 3 tests (3/3 consecutive, taken as 5 consecutive) | 5 | 5/5 green, 15/15 tests | 6.7–7.5 s (7.7–8.6 s) |
| Enlarged allowlist, `pnpm run test:e2e:live:ci` (the 5/5) | 5 | 5/5 green, 75/75 tests | 38.5–40.3 s (39.5–41.4 s) |

<details><summary>Per-test time over the 5 pair runs (min–max)</summary>

| Test | Time |
|---|---|
| row-action `visible` predicates are CEL-evaluated (unchanged) | 2.0–2.3 s |
| nav entry bare-string `visible` read as CEL (new) | 1.5–1.7 s |
| full-page edit form opened by URL saves, toasts, stays in the app (new) | 2.3–2.9 s |

</details>

Budget: about +5 s on the step locally (incumbent 34.8 s, enlarged 38.5–40.3 s). The job comment in `ci.yml` measured the incumbent four-spec step at 14–24 s on CI; this PR's own `Live E2E UI` run is the first CI reading of the eight-file step, projected well inside the 120 s budget.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per scenario, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs under the verify lock, Console rebuilt per leg)</summary>

Both specs ran in each leg, so each leg also shows the other scenario's test staying green.

- **#27454:** `RecordFormPage.tsx` anchor `const hasInAppHistory = location.key !== 'default';` replaced with `const hasInAppHistory = window.history.length > 1;` (the pre-fix test). Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob dd43d8e6 to 70c521b1); the rebuilt bundle carries `history.length>1` once (0 before). Result: `record-form-direct-url` red (`Task "…" updated` toast not found: the page went Back to `about:blank`), the two CEL tests green.
- **#27457:** `ExpressionEvaluator.ts` anchor `if (!unwrappedEnvelope) {` replaced with a branch that never takes the CEL route for a bare string and carries a string marker. Mutation landed (blob 484f34de to 4ac105fe); the rebuilt bundle carries the marker once. Result: the nav case red (`CEL Shown Entry` not visible), the row-action case and the record-form test green.
- **Restore:** both files restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty (the tool's own verdict), the Console rebuilt from HEAD, both markers 0 in the bundle, and every reading above was taken after that.

</details>

<details><summary>Gate lines (command :: exit code)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 31 families from the three changed paths; each ran locally, plus `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:e2e` (the program lists both changed spec files) and `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 34 lines, every one exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 31 derived, 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. CI runs the rest (the repo-wide scans, `Live E2E UI` itself).
